page.title: Build your trip, day by day
page.lead: Pick destinations and dates, add hotels, food, trains, sights and experiences, arrange them into days and see the estimated budget. Share the plan or send it to a travel manager for a confirmed offer.

ai.title: Let the AI planner draft your days
ai.text: It reads your destinations, dates, travellers and chosen items, and suggests a day-by-day plan you can add to your trip.
ai.needInput: Choose at least one destination or add an item first.
ai.busy: The planner is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
ai.network: No connection to the planner. Check your internet and try again.
ai.error: The planner could not draft this trip. Please try again.

request.ask: Put the days in a sensible order and suggest sights and experiences for each day.

ai.fromCatalogue: Drafted from our ready-made routes and your chosen destinations. Add the suggestions you like to your days.

share.title: Get a link to this trip
share.text: Save a copy of the plan and share it with your travel companions. Anyone with the link can open it in their own constructor.
share.saveAgain: Save changes under a new link
share.changed: You changed the trip after saving. Save again to share the latest version.

share.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
share.invalid: This trip cannot be saved. Remove a few items and try again.
share.error: The trip could not be saved. Please try again.

inquiry.title: Send this trip to a travel manager
inquiry.text: A travel manager checks availability for every item, confirms the prices and sends you an offer. Nothing is booked or paid until you agree.
inquiry.needMore: Choose destinations and future travel dates above to send the request.

teaser.title: Design your own journey in minutes
teaser.text: Combine hotels, trains, sights, food and experiences into a day-by-day plan with a live budget. When it looks right, a travel manager turns it into a confirmed trip.

step1.title: Where and when
step1.text: Pick destinations, dates and who is travelling.

step2.title: Add services
step2.text: Hotels, restaurants, trains, flights, sights and experiences.

step3.title: Arrange the days
step3.text: Put items into days yourself, or let Auto-arrange and AI do it.

step4.title: Budget and send
step4.text: See the estimate, share the link, request a confirmed offer.
